title: dactylorhiza × turcestanica
intro: Dactylorhiza × turcestanica, commonly known as a hybrid orchid, is a cross between the Dactylorhiza pachphylla and Dactylorhiza romana orchid species. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve blood circulation, and exhibit anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza × turcestanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
